## Lesser Whisperer (CR 10)

**XP** 9,600  
NE Large fey  
**Init** +13; **Senses** blindsight 60 ft., darkvision 60 ft., low-light vision; Perception +28  
**Aura** distortion (30 ft., DC 28)  


**Defense**


**AC** 22, touch 19, flat-footed 17 (+4 Dex, +1 dodge, +5 insight, -1 size, +3 natural)  
**hp** 200 (20d6+80); fast healing 5  
**Fort** +10, **Ref** +16, **Will** +17  
**Defensive Abilities** anticipation, faceless; **Immune** cold, mind-affecting effects, gaze attacks, poison, scent-based attacks, sonic DR 15/cold iron; SR 21  


**Offense**


**Speed** 30 ft.  
**Melee** 2 claws +15 (1d8+5/19-20) and mist tendrils +15 touch (6d6/19-20 plus cursed wound)  
**Space** 10 ft.; **Reach** 10 ft.  
**Special Attacks** cursed wound  
**Spell-Like Abilities** (CL 10th; concentration +18)  


Constant—detect thoughts  

At will—darkness, dimension door, gaseous form, ghost sound (DC 18), invisibility, paranoia (DC 20), selective invisibility, suggestion (DC 21)  

3/day—quickened confusion (DC 22), crushing despair (DC 22), hold person (DC 21), phantasmal killer (DC 22)  

1/day—dominate person (DC 23), nightmare (DC 23)  



**Statistics**


**Str** 20, **Dex** 19, **Con** 18, **Int** 19, **Wis** 20, **Cha** 27  
**Base Atk** +10; **CMB** +16; **CMD** 36  
**Feats** Combat Reflexes, Dimensional Agility, [Dodgility](../../rules/feats/dodge.md), Improved Critical (claw, mist tendrils), Improved Initiative, Quicken Spell-Like Ability (confusion), Skill Focus (Stealth), Weapon Focus (claw, mist tendrils)  
*House rules: Dodge is part of Dodgility.*  
**Skills** Escape Artist +27, Intimidate +28, Knowledge (arcana, planes) +24, Knowledge (geography, local, nature) +27, Perception +28, Sense Motive +28, Stealth +29  
**Languages** Aklo, Common, Sylvan (can’t speak); telepathy 100 ft.  


**Special Abilities**


**Anticipation (Ex)** A lesser whisperer applies its Wisdom modifier to initiative checks and as an insight bonus to its Armor Class.  

**Cursed Wound (Su)** Damage caused by a whisperer’s mist tendrils overcomes all damage reduction and ignores all hardness, but damage the tendrils deal to objects is halved. Mist tendril damage does not heal naturally. A character attempting to use magical healing on a creature damaged in this way must succeed at a DC 21 caster level check or the healing has no effect on the injured creature. Mist tendrils are primary natural touch attacks that create deep, bloodless, crater-shaped wounds.  

**Distortion Aura (Su)** All creatures within 30 feet of a lesser whisperer experience significant sensory distortion that grows harsher the closer they are to the lesser whisperer. The first time it ends its turn within the aura, a creature must make a DC 28 Will save or become sickened for as long as it stays within the aura. If the creature succeeds at the saving throw, it cannot be affected again by the sickening effect of this aura for another 24 hours. Creatures 30 feet from a lesser whisperer take a -2 penalty on Perception and concentration checks, which increases by 2 for every 5 feet that the creature is closer to a lesser whisperer (up to -12 for the creatures adjacent). This effect is not affected by the Will save. The save DC is Charisma-based.  

**Faceless (Ex)** A lesser whisperer has no face, but can still see in all directions as if its entire body were an eye. It is immune to gaze attacks, but not to vision-based illusions. It has no need to breathe, and is immune to all inhaled and scent-based effects.  


**Ecology**


**Environment** any  
**Organization** solitary  
**Treasure** standard
